name: Carlo's Wonderful Butcher Shop & Friends!
source:
A short prologue visual novel featuring a cast of colourful characters! Play as Carlo as he opens his butcher shop for the day and talk to his friends! 

[From [url=https://sigyaad.itch.io/carlos-wonderful-butcher-shop-friends]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部短篇序章视觉小说，登场角色个个个性鲜明！扮演Carlo，开始一天的肉铺营业，并和朋友们聊聊天吧！

[来源：[url=https://sigyaad.itch.io/carlos-wonderful-butcher-shop-friends]Itch.io[/url]]
